description: For a helper session that is not in the call: returns the answers to its own questions (same credential and helper_name) as events [{type: decision, id, number, verdict: yes|no|option|other, option?, text?, by, answered_by, answered_via, answered_by_label}], plus question_check events (a status or activity line of this helper reads like a question to the person: id, quote, wait_s, text; answered by helper_decide with the question or with no_question = id), plus user_turn events (the person addressed this helper by name in the call: text as transcribed, to, ts), waiting up to `timeout` seconds (0-25) when none is there. At most 50 kept per helper, gone when the call ends.

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

name: helper_next
title: Helper: answers to own decisions
